groups.scope: Fixed-class Gauduchon trace compactness; minimal multiplicities and regularization; finite intersections for the non-Kahler locus; isolated-pole gluing; classical class-C and null-locus inputs retain historical dependency scope; the nonclosed zero-class error supremum does not measure class positivity.
Closed pointed pseudoeffective cone and compact possibly empty trace-one slice; modification class maps continuous; linear trace gives no nonlinear Monge-Ampere mass bound.

Positive-dimensional Kähler resolutions and common refinements; finite mass bound; non-pluripolar mass transported off exceptional sets; nef intersection formula and normalized diagonal coefficient M; strict-current descent; rank-drop zero; null locus is a union, not a pointwise vanishing statement for each contained subvariety.

Bounded residual extends positively across the divisor; nefness and polynomial intersection masses; common-resolution divisorial coefficient invariance; positive trace mass gives one-sided strict comparison; matching ordinary type requires the stated smooth positive residual; exceptional curve gives the obstruction.

Nonzero L1 density and c>0 imply b>0; coefficient bound c<=b(1-kappa)^n allows kappa=0; weak maximizing limits annihilate smooth divisor class; selected uniform integrability gives maximizers; the exposed face belongs to the smooth-test closure.
Exceptional negative-curve integration current lies outside the smooth-test closure; semipositive divisor exclusion uses determinant rank loss and no density mass on its zero set.

Nef divisor variational volume vanishes at threshold under the selected uniform integrability condition; the Hopf semipositive exclusion works even when the volume obstruction is vacuous and uses no bounded mass property.

Exact horizontal product forces positive ddc-closed (1,1)-current descent; closedness descends; compact-fiber harmonic potentials give Bott-Chern injectivity and cone coefficients; ideals at every positive weight, envelopes and weighted section norms descend; top mass vanishes.
Exact cubic perturbation volume and q horizontal positive coefficients give order 3-q; growth degree q is an explicit-family relation; fixed-density volume is not a conserved mass for all potentials.

Equation metrics are Gauduchon minimizing tests; normalized squares converge in smooth norms, with complementary ranks 1,2,3; rank-two limit is not a semipositive square; denominator scales epsilon^(q/3), without concentration.

Classical full-mass existence and minimal-singularity bounds retain source scope; analytic strict barrier has exact non-Kahler polar set; global regular-locus positive smooth density gives ample-locus regularity, without distance information.

Ramification and Hopf pullbacks; eigenvalue determinant/trace bounds and Schur complement; endpoint construction requires n>=2, now explicit; exceptional vertical entries vanish quadratically; compact Pogorelov density is only globally Lp; power blowup Jacobian exponent n*gamma-1 and finite-distance models.

Inverse radial equation m^n=n integral t^(n-1)D; boundedness integral m/s differs from normal length integral sqrt(mprime)/(2sqrt(s)); no differentiation of asymptotic error; iterated logarithmic thresholds d>n and d>2n give continuous minimal complete ends; zero residual Lelong number alone is insufficient.

Curve Poisson equation and product measure extension have no atom; explicit power and logarithmic primitives with threshold b>2; unbounded sublogarithmic potentials have trivial ideals but nonminimal ordinary type; uniqueness comparison invoked only in the closed Kähler regime.

Nonnef projective blowup example: residual beta and 2[E], exponential pole cancellation, smooth positive volume extension, minimal type and finite energy, comparison of finite exponential densities despite infinite reference measure; pulled-back metric has finite exit paths.

Nef-big radial example: exact convex profile end identities extend positive volume; zero Lelong numbers with unbounded nonminimal cusp; transition truncation masses give finite energy; divisor D complete, null curve E at finite distance.

Compatible initial log resolution on P1xP1 blown up at p: R0 Kähler, coefficients mH=mE=2, bH=0,bE=1, lambda=2; prescribed source volume fixed; auxiliary class nonnef; cusp Volterra construction and truncation energy; minimal-reference Lelong numbers do not imply minimal type; nef plus compatibility remains open.

Intrinsic tangential plane ker partial tau, normal Schur complement and proper Lipschitz exhaustion prove all-path completeness for exponent <=2; torus profiles give sharp threshold, including n=1; logarithmically weakened integrable poles do not decide smooth-coefficient nonintegrable compatible-flow case.

Dense complex kernel equals positive-current rigidity and collapse in a fixed positive direction; Fourier distributions and real quotient character; unrestricted flat family with determinant t^4 and indefinite difference collapses at a nonrigid class.

Sixteen O(-2) quotient-resolution charts; local radial replacement and cutoff curvature yield Kähler metric; even admissible profiles descend by zero and differ by smooth global potentials; cycles avoiding fixed points have periods 1 and irrational a.

Four disjoint blowup centers, generating conics, degree-zero curves and vanishing adjoints; central half-log metric; harmonic-slice persistence forces coefficient-one obstruction; all extendable metrics exactly divisor metric times pencil pullback; least-singular assertion only among extendable metrics.

Admissible number-field action retains classical construction source scope; real translations dense by trace-form and embedding independence; Liouville leaves force finite continuous transverse convex potentials and vanishing top mass; finite Lelong levels only t=1; invariant threefold masses have two-sided bounds, general fluctuation remains open; averaged coefficient product growth excludes signed-ddc metrics for s>=2.
